caption:
Mushroom & Cheese Chilli Omlette
under 300 calorie | 15 minute breakfasts | high protein

Nutrition: 
C: 6 | F: 17 | P: 22
Calories: 291 per serve (without bread)
Serves 1

Ingredients
2 eggs + 1/2 tbsp milk +salt + pepper
knobb of butter \ few sprays of oil 
50 grams button mushroom
25 grams cheese, your choice :) 
1 green chilli, chopped
salt + pepper, to taste
 
method
cook mushrooms and green chillies till done, remove
in the same pan, cook the beaten eggs in the pan, flip it over and place the mushroom mix, top with cheese
fold and serve it hot  with sourdough bread OR as is :)
